subject.title: fix(telegram): add renderMode config to skip HTML rendering on macOS

question: Should OpenClaw accept an account-wide Telegram `renderMode: raw` config workaround for the macOS rendering bug, or should this stay focused on the specific `/model` and `/commands` renderer path?
rationale: Both paths are plausible, but the PR adds new config surface and only partially wires it; maintainer intent is needed before automation can decide whether to complete raw mode or reject that product shape.

options.title: Retarget To Reported Paths
options.body: Fix the actual `/model` and `/commands` emitting path with focused Telegram Desktop proof and avoid a new account-wide render mode unless it proves necessary.

options.title: Complete Raw Mode
options.body: Keep the new config option, but thread it through every Telegram delivery/edit path, update generated metadata and hints, and prove it in native Telegram Desktop.

options.title: Pause Behind Canonical Issue
options.body: Leave this PR blocked while maintainers decide the product shape on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93804.

recommendation.title: Retarget To Reported Paths
recommendation.body: Fix the actual `/model` and `/commands` emitting path with focused Telegram Desktop proof and avoid a new account-wide render mode unless it proves necessary.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently owned the Telegram rich-message compatibility gate that most closely matches this config/default decision.
